text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you there? Did you see it? Do you 
know where it is!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's gonna be interestin'!! 
Where the hell are ya, Mr. Fun-and-Games?!

I got caught by Gold Ship during my break. 
She seems even more frustrated than 
usual...
choice_data_list: Why are you wearing your racing outfit?
Why are you wearing your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, what? I was bored, so I was having a 
solo fashion show.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And then, the moment I put my arms through 
these sleeves, I suddenly felt an 
overwhelming urge to do something even 
more fun than juggling sea urchins!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...!? Golshi-san... That racing outfit...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I can feel it... Something... truly 
extraordinary...
(Rumble, rumble, rumble!!!)

Just then, accompanied by intense tremors, 
the surrounding area was enveloped in 
light!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship and the Others
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what the heck?! What was that 
light just now— ............Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship and the Others
text_block_list.text:
Nwooooooohh...!? What on eaaarth is 
thiiis!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That silky silver hair and those sexy, 
ennui-filled eyes! No matter how you look 
at it, that's totally me, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking! Always bright, 
cheering everyone up with all your 
racket... That's basically me!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"From Golshi-san in her racewear... a 
powerful aura... is overflowing...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......This is merely a guess, but... 
Perhaps Golshi-san's strong feelings gave 
human form to her racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Though I do not understand... why 
it turned out like this...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about reasons! A situation this 
fun, you just gotta enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, think you can keep up with 
me? My thirst for fun is on a whole other 
level compared to yours!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say!? Fine, let's settle 
this with a match!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship and the Others
text_block_list.text:
We're settling whose radar for fun is 
better with an 'Eye-Blinking Endurance 
Battle'!!
choice_data_list: What kind of contest is this?!
What kind of contest is this?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I ain't gonna miss a single fun second. So 
we're gonna test our hunger by seeing who 
can hold out without blinking the 
longest!!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just leaving it wide open is boring! This 
is a life-or-death, down-to-the-wire 
showdown!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So with that, your job is to give my 
eyeballs a brutal trial! Come at me with 
everything you've got!!
choice_data_list:
So, we just have to make the two of them 
blink?

So, we just have to make the two of them 
blink?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, I suppose... Let's get 
this over with... quickly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If I dry it... with the wind... ...Hup.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Naive! Sweeter than sweet shrimp! I do 
anti-dryness training on a daily basis! 
Not that I ever told anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Then... how about this? If water gets in, 
she'll have to close her eyes...

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey heeeey!! Stop pulling those lame, 
half-assed jokes on me!!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Did you forget I'm from Atlantis?! 
Seawater, freshwater, tap water! No matter 
what water gets in my eyes, it won't 
bother me one bit!

I was at my wit's end... Every single 
strategy I tried proved utterly useless, 
leaving me with no choice but to watch how 
the match unfolded.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
......Hey. What's up, Golshi? Your 
eyelid's twitching like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Look who's talkin', Golshi. You look 
like a dried-up squid yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship and the Others
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaarrrrghh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!! My eyeeees!!!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guh... M-more importantly, the results!! 
Hey, Trainer! Who won!?

The two Gold Ships closed their eyes 
almost simultaneously! However, going by 
pure intuition—
choice_data_list:
The winner is Gold Ship in her school 
uniform!

By a narrow margin, Gold Ship in her 
racing silks wins!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aw yeah! We did iiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Not bad at all. I'd expect nothing 
less from the one who created me.

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll grant ya the title of Golshi King! 
Wear me and blow up a storm across the 
whole wide world! A massive Golshi 
whirlwind, that is!!

As the light enveloped them once more, 
Gold Ship was back to being just one 
person.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, what? What, it's over already? I 
wanted to have some more fun, man.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, I got the title of Golshi King, so 
whatever! Time to unleash it upon the 
world... the Golshi Whirlwind!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"You might just... make the world more 
interesting... ...Wearing that racing 
outfit, Golshi-san."

text_block_list.name: Racewear Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Peace peace☆ Welp... that body is 
mine now, don't mind if I dooo!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? A racing outfit rebellion, you 
say!!?? I won't let youuuu!!!

As the two Gold Ships scuffled, they were 
engulfed in light. And then— Gold Ship was 
back to being just one person.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Whew! That was close! Almost got 
completely taken over there!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was a fiery battle! It was a 
blast, FIREEE!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is it because she suppressed that 
racewear...? I can feel a wild, ferocious 
power emanating from Golshi-san... even 
stronger than before...!
